newsitem.title: USA: Cognex sees Q2 EPS, revs above estimates.
newsitem.headline: Cognex sees Q2 EPS, revs above estimates.

text.p: Cognex Corp Chief Financial Officer John Rogers said Friday he expects second quarter earnings to exceed the Wall Street consensus estimate of $0.17 a share but fall short of the year-earlier $0.23 a share.
Cognex expects second quarter revenues to exceed the previous record of $34.9 million set in the year-ago quarter, Rogers told Reuters.
Analysts expect Cognex to report second quarter revenues of $31-$33 million, Rogers said.
Shares of Cognex, which maker computer vision products for the semiconductor and electronics industries, were up 4-3/8 to 31-1/8.
Rogers attributed the better-than-expected second quarter outlook to improving demand in customers' business.
"We sell our products to the semiconductor and electronics industries. Their business has been picking up -- the industry cycle has been improving -- so our business is picking up now too," he said.
Rogers declined to comment specifically on the outlook for the remainder of the year but said, "If we do well in the second quarter, that will translate into the rest of the year."
